html:
The Mekong Cruise will bring visitors exciting experiences, and admire the beauty of a river region, you will have an interesting vacation on a cruise on the floating water in the Mekong.

When experiencing on the cruises in the floating season in the Mekong, it will bring you outstanding experiences that cannot be found anywhere else.

In addition to enjoying the attractive cuisine – famous specialties of the West, you can enjoy it right on the cruise, and freely admire the scenery on the deck, soak in the cool water at the infinity pool of the cruise, the bar or the mini golf course on the cruise and enjoy the best vacation.

If you are someone who loves to admire the scenery of the flood season on a cruise, take a Mekong tour with Vietlook Travel today to experience on the cruises, which will bring you the most enjoyable vacation.

Take a trip to the West once to see with your own eyes the idyllic beauty of the Mekong River region, and experience the unique culture, and have exciting experiences on a cruise during the flood season.

The cruise is luxuriously designed with a modern style, the interior is harmoniously decorated, has large windows and private balconies to help visitors enjoy the beauty and unique nuances of the peaceful space of the immense river region creating a beautiful picture.

On the cruise ships, you can experience free services right on the boat such as: swimming pool, jacuzzi, reading room, movie theater, spa, gym… and have a view of the immense river.

In addition, when traveling to the Mekong River, you can participate in the experience on small boats gliding through the blue canals, surrounded by rows of water coconut trees, or rows of cool green trees, visitors can admire the poetic scenery on the river, or visit the fruit-laden garden.

When getting on the small boats to visit the riverside spots in Can Tho, An Giang, Dong Thap… you can choose different sightseeing routes depending on your preferences.

When coming to Long Xuyen, visitors want to experience the simple life of the people here, you can visit the floating market and enjoy cups of coffee while watching the scenery of a river area, then visitors can visit the An Giang museum, Ong Ho island, visit the craft villages making bonsai pots, incense, ancient temples… of Long Xuyen.

When night falls, the boat will anchor in the middle of the river for tourists to spend the night on the cruise. Tourists traveling to the Mekong are most crowded during the flood season, and it is divided into 2 stages, the first stage is from January to March and October to December, however, the most crowded time is from June to August, when tourists from all over the world flock to the West to visit and enjoy the scenery.

Ho Chi Minh Mekong Cruise 3 Days 2 Nights Itinerary

Day 1: Saigon – Can Tho – Long Xuyen

  • You will arrive at the city center and move to Cai Cui Can Tho port at 15:00. Boarding the boat, visitors will listen to safety instructions and the tour itinerary, visitors will enjoy a refreshing cocktail watching the sunset on the Hau River and watch the performance of “Don ca tai tu”.
  • In the evening, visitors will learn to cook with the chef, then enjoy dinner on the cruise, then freely watch movies and stay overnight on the ship.

Day 2: Long Xuyen – Chau Doc (4 hours), Chau Doc – Long Xuyen (6 hours).

  • As the ship moves to the South, visitors will enjoy a meal on the cruise, participate in activities right on the cruise, and enjoy cocktails watching the poetic scenery.
  • At noon, visitors will learn to cook with the chef on the cruise and enjoy the dishes they have just prepared.
  • After enjoying lunch, you go to explore the Tra Su Melaleuca forest, you can take a small boat through the canals surrounded by rows of cool green trees, and flooded forests.
  • Then return to the boat to depart for Long Xuyen, you have lunch and dinner, then relax. Overnight in Long Xuyen.

Day 3: Long Xuyen – Tan Loc – Can Tho – Saigon.

  • In the morning, wake up early to join a relaxing Yoga class to enjoy the scenery from the morning boat. Have breakfast with delicious dishes with the rich flavors of the Mekong River region.
  • The boat will move towards Tan Loc Islet, you visit the traditional wine cellar making process to produce famous jars of wine, you taste the wine and hear about the wine brewing method, then you can buy it as a gift.
  • Visit Tan Loc Islet, visit the Sau Tia plum garden, one of the specialties of Sau Tia plum wine.

You return to the ship for lunch and dinner on the cruise before the boat moves back to Can Tho. The 3-day 2-night Mekong tour ends at 3:00 p.m.
